name: G-Tec Janix Education Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Keerti Knowledge and Skills Ltd is in the field of Information Technology related computer services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KKSL is an education company which provides knowledge sharing, skill development through practical training to the youngsters of India. It is an ISO 9001:2015 certified organization with quality training delivery, processes, pedagogies and systems that ensures a seamless and affordable education & training through classroom and instructor led programs, Central and State government programs and CSR projects

pros: Debtor days have improved from 165 to 126 days.

cons: Stock is trading at 14.2 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -15.9% over last 3 years.
